_notes: game_state added locally, from a 4-player game driven through the cabinet's streamer.
current_player and current_ball are adjacent in CPU RAM at 0x00032AB8 and 0x00032AB9, player low
Scores are 4 bytes on 4-byte centres from 0x021109E4. The sweep also offered 0x00036470 in CPU
RAM, reading 251,000 / 250,500 / 250,500 / 251,500 -- four plausible, evenly spaced, monotonic
values, and wrong. Scores are in NVRAM on every SAM game measured, which is what rejects it.
checksum16 declared for all twelve champion records: 32-byte records, initials at +0, score at
+0x18 (Best Combo keeps a 1-byte counter at +0x1A instead), little-endian checksum16 at +28 as
0xFFFF minus the sum of the first 28 bytes -- start..length 30 covers the summed bytes plus the
checksum. All twelve validate against a captured NVRAM image.
game_over, tilted and credits come from a 1,099-frame recording of live memory spanning an
0x00032AEA is the status bitfield most SAM games keep at ball+0x31, in trn_174h's exact
encoding: 1 in attract, 19 (0x13) in play, 21 (0x15) for the eighteen samples between the tilt
and the end of the tilted ball, during which player 1's score sat frozen at 138,820. game_over
(mask 0x12, inverted) is correct in all 1,099 frames; tilted is bit 0x04.
credits at 0x0211100C, the sixteenth SAM game at that address: rose to 9 with the coins (capped
by the Maximum Credits just set) and fell to 8 at game start.
smanve_100 is not claimed: V1.00 keeps the offset-0 adjustment layout and its records and CPU
counters elsewhere.
2026-11: The A.1 (64) and A.2 (49) adjustments added from the ROM image (README, 'Adjustments
from the ROM').
Confirmed on a cabinet 2026-11-13 (ALP4K; two players, tilt on P1 ball 1): 2,318,440 /
1,847,610, the records and the status byte matched the DMD.
